svg.title: Reservation record lifecycle
svg.desc: A confirmed Checkout creates an Active Reservation. Renewal keeps that same record Active. A committed changed or No Change Check-in or governed cancel makes it Released. Lease timeout makes it Expired. Authorized recovery makes the old record Recovered. Released, Expired and Recovered records never become Active again; any later Checkout creates a new Reservation against the current head.
